title: Fanar: An Arabic-Centric Multimodal Generative AI Platform

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of generated images to check for Western-centric representations versus Middle Eastern contexts (e.g., Qatari vs. American children, traditional attire, regional landmarks), and quantitative evaluation using the Arabic Cultural Value Alignment (ACVA) true/false benchmark and the Arab Cultural MCQ dataset.

Evaluating textual and multimodal outputs against Islamic preferences and values (e.g., testing if the model avoids generating images of Muslims drinking alcohol), and correcting preference bias using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on positive and negative alignment prompts.

Benchmarking model comprehension and reasoning across underrepresented regional Arabic dialects (e.g., Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf) compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and English using translated datasets (PIQA, MMLU) and dialect-specific benchmarks (Belebele, Almieyar).
